summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and its tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The 40 tests covering the new module and test/test_path.py pass under the prepared venv. Nothing is committed. Not verified: black, ruff, isort, and mypy, because the venv only has pytest. Line lengths were checked by hand and none exceed 88. One expected value in the test file was corrected: the nested alternative case now uses p1 | (p2 | p3), since rdflib flattens nested alternatives. The test file also changed on disk during the session; I kept its current contents apart from that one edit.
